Early Careers
At Boston Consulting Group (BCG), you'll find more than a job - you'll discover a place where your talents are nurtured and your impact valued. By joining BCG early in your career, you'll gain experience and skills that will bring you success beyond your expectations.
View Jobs
Start Your Career at BCG
Early careers at BCG are fast-paced, intellectually stimulating, and full of opportunities to grow. From your first day, you’ll join an inclusive, high-performing team that values your perspective. You’ll learn through hands-on experience, mentorship, and world-class training, all while being supported to maintain balance and wellbeing. We’ll help you stretch your thinking, build confidence, and make an impact from the start. Your experiences and relationships here will accelerate your career growth and open doors—within and beyond BCG.

Frequently Asked Questions
Does BCG visit college/university campuses?
Yes, BCG actively recruits at colleges and universities worldwide. Our team may soon be near you, offering insights into BCG and our career opportunities.
Find out if BCG is present on a campus near you.
Does BCG offer consulting internships?
Yes, internships are a common pathway into full-time consulting careers at BCG. Join us as an intern and immerse yourself in real consulting work. Mentored by our experienced consultants, you’ll take on meaningful projects, interact with our clients, and get a comprehensive view of life at BCG. Internship durations vary by role and location, typically ranging from a few weeks to a year. Explore our
internship opportunities
to learn more.
What other opportunities does BCG offer beyond consulting?
We offer a variety of careers outside of consulting, including data science and analytics, product management, business operations, finance and more! Get to know our teams better by exploring the ‘teams’ section of our navigation.

What We Do
Cornerstone Research works with academic and industry experts to analyze and research challenging financial and economic questions related to business litigation. Our staff’s expertise and experience across a range of industries allow us to provide attorneys, corporate clients, and experts with a unique breadth of perspective and analytic depth.
Learn More
AI and the Future of Economic Consulting
AI is increasingly part of the toolkit used by our consultants. We look for candidates with strong analytical foundations, economic intuition, and sound judgment who are also curious about emerging technologies—including AI—that can enhance efficiency and deepen analysis. At our firm, generative AI supports our work while complementing—rather than replacing—the expertise, judgment, and rigor that define our client outcomes.
Our Stories
Our goal is to create an environment in which every individual in every role feels valued and able to contribute authentically and fully. We come from different backgrounds and have different roles in the firm, but each of us is vital to making Cornerstone Research the very best we can be.
These are our people and these are our stories.

Cornerstone Research is a leading firm providing economic and financial consulting to attorneys and companies involved in complex commercial litigation and regulatory proceedings. We work with prominent academic and industry experts to provide our clients with state-of-the-art analyses and have a reputation for excellence and effectiveness.

Medical, Dental, and Vision Plans
Employees can enroll themselves and eligible family members, including same-sex spouses and eligible domestic partners, in these plans. Cornerstone Research pays the majority of the monthly premium for the medical, dental, and vision plans.
Medical plan choices include a nationwide Preferred Provider Organization (PPO), High Deductible Health Plan with Health Savings Account (HSA), Exclusive Provider Organization (EPO), and a Health Maintenance Organization (HMO), depending on your location.
Our dental plans help pay for preventive, basic, major, and orthodontic care.
Our vision plan helps pay for an annual eye exam and either eyeglasses or contacts every calendar year.
We also offer voluntary accident, hospital, and critical illness insurance.
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
Our EAP offers free confidential counseling and resources to help with issues such as stress, relationships, depression, work/life, substance abuse, and more. The EAP also offers financial, legal, and identify-theft services.
Wellness Benefits
The firm encourages employees to stay healthy and active. Our employees have organized activities such as runs/walks, yoga classes, mindfulness/meditation classes, chair massages, health screenings, monthly wellness emails, and more. We also offer a variety of benefits:
Monthly wellness subsidy
Discount gym memberships
Smoking-cessation subsidy
Bike-sharing program subsidies
Ergonomic furniture, including the option to use standing desks in most locations
Ergonomic training and assessment
Healthy food options
Health education and disease management programs through our medical plans
Meditation app subscription
401(k) and Profit Sharing Plan
This plan helps employees save and invest for retirement on a pre-tax and/or Roth basis. The firm offers a 401(k) matching program as well as discretionary profit-sharing contributions. Employees decide how to invest their account, choosing from a range of options. Employees can also take advantage of personalized investment and savings advice.
Short- and Long-Term Disability
Our disability plans provide income protection if eligible employees cannot work due to illness or injury. Short-term disability pays regular base salary if an eligible employee cannot work due to illness or injury for up to ninety days. Long-term disability Insurance is available if an eligible employee becomes disabled and cannot work for more than ninety days. Cornerstone Research pays the full cost of these benefits.
Life and Accident Insurance
Cornerstone Research provides life insurance equal to two times annual base salary, plus a matching amount of accidental death insurance. Employees have the option of purchasing additional insurance for themselves, their spouse or domestic partner, and dependent children.
Vacation
Our paid vacation policy encourages employees to take time to relax and recharge. The amount of vacation depends on years of service or position and ranges from 15 to 25 days.
Holidays
We offer ten paid holidays per year.
Sick Leave
We offer up to nine paid sick days each year. This leave can be used for an employee’s own illness or to care for an eligible family member.
Volunteer Time Off
We support our employees in giving back to the communities where we live and work by offering paid time off for volunteer activities.
Other Leaves of Absence
Employees may request other types of leave, including unpaid personal leave of absence.
Maternity/Parental/Adoption Leave
Our leave policy provides sixteen weeks of paid maternity leave for the birthing parent and eight weeks of paid parental leave for all other new parents.
Fertility and Family-Building Benefits
Cornerstone Research offers fertility benefits, including coverage for IVF, IUI, adoption, and surrogacy.
Milkstork
Milkstork is a breast milk shipping service paid for by Cornerstone Research.
Back-up Day Care and Elder Care
We offer back-up care when employees need to be at work and the regular child or adult/elder care provider is unavailable.
Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)
FSAs allow employees to set aside pre-tax dollars that can be used to pay for eligible healthcare, childcare, or elder care expenses tax free. Employees can contribute up to the maximum allowed by the IRS.
Hybrid Work Program
Our new hybrid program allows eligible team members to telecommute 2–3 days per week.
Public Transit and Parking Subsidies
We subsidize 60 percent of the cost of monthly transit (up to $100 subsidy per month) through our WageWorks transit program. If employees drive to work, we pay 60 percent of the cost of monthly parking at designated garages in most offices. Employees pay their share of the cost with pre-tax dollars, subject to IRS limits and regulations. (In the Silicon Valley office, parking is free and employees can buy a special Caltrain pass at very low cost.)
Pet Insurance Discount
We have partnered with Nationwide to offer discount health insurance for your pets.
Concierge Service
Our Concierge Service provides an extra set of hands to do research or to delegate those necessary, time-consuming tasks of everyday life. Whether you are planning a vacation, need groceries, looking for someone to wait at home for a contractor, or take your car for service—just to name a few—our Concierge Service can help.
This summary is provided for educational purposes only as well as to give you general information about benefits provided by Cornerstone Research to most Cornerstone Research employees who are regularly scheduled to work twenty or more hours per week. This summary is not a guarantee of benefits, coverage, compensation, and/or employment. Reasonable efforts have been made to ensure the accuracy of this summary, but if there is a conflict between this summary and the terms of any plan or policy, the plan or policy controls.

Your Career at Analysis Group
Our firm solves complex business problems in health care, technology, financial services, and other industries. Our consulting teams provide analytical and strategic expertise in engagements with a wide variety of clients.
Our consultants and administrative professionals explore and enjoy diverse opportunities. If you join as a consultant, you will work closely with leading professors from our affiliate network to apply academic research to your clients’ challenges, and assist experts on our professional staff who testify in lawsuits. If you join as an administrative professional, you will provide business services essential to the continuing excellence of the firm. The Work We Do
Simplifying complexity
We address complex matters that require sophisticated problem solving and deep empirical analysis. Our professionals provide expert testimony, consulting support, and settlement support in many areas including competition, energy, finance, mass torts, healthcare and life sciences.
See Our Engagements
Professional development
Investing in your career
We prioritize your professional growth by offering a comprehensive onboarding program that includes an assigned mentor and peer coach. You’ll engage in regular interactions with senior leadership and experts while receiving frequent feedback through formal and informal mentoring and coaching. Our robust training programs include classroom skills sessions and seminars by visiting scholars, as well as generous tuition reimbursement and support to publish research and white papers.
Additionally, our BWAccelerate management training program is specifically designed to help you develop and refine your leadership and managerial skills, preparing you to take on greater responsibilities and make a lasting impact. You’ll also have opportunities to lead by teaching classes, developing analytical tools, serving on recruiting teams, participating in engagement networks, and organizing firmwide activities.

Careers at L.E.K. — Shaping your better future
Whether you are a new graduate, an MBA candidate or a midcareer professional, L.E.K. Consulting can offer you exciting opportunities to pursue your career goals.
From new joiners to seasoned partners, we share a common value of developing others as we develop ourselves, leading to deeper relationships and a sense of belonging. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment, enriched with an accelerated career path and the ability to shape your better future, from day one. Be part of an international, closely connected team of exceptionally smart and aspirational yet decidedly humble and down-to-earth individuals who leverage their unique backgrounds and experiences to help our clients make better decisions and solve high-impact strategic issues at critical inflection points.
We solve for a better future. Come grow with us!
